A vampire cannot use a taste of Vitae if he stole the blood correct?

For example

vampire uses a theft of vitae and steals 2 blood, can this vampire
then play a taste of Vitae ontop of that? I dont think so....but our
group is fighting over this...

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
sbe...@isomedia.com (Shane) writes:
>A vampire cannot use a taste of Vitae if he stole the blood correct?

Correct. Taste has errata saying that it only counts blood lost
to heal damage (or prevent destruction in the case of agg damage).
